probe.choice: iwet: bucket water balance on the IMERG Late store, lag 2 IMD days

candidates.candidate: SMAP L4 surface and root-zone soil moisture (SPL4SMGP / SPL4SMAU)
candidates.coverage: from 2015-03-31: 2015-2017 only of the development years
candidates.latency: newest granule ended 63 h before the probe (CMR)
candidates.size: 143 MB per 3-hourly global granule; needs spatial subsetting
candidates.why: 8 of the 11 development years have no data; 347 of the 789 development positives fall after its start, and a model would treat the absence as a year effect

candidates.candidate: ERA5 volumetric soil water, ARCO-ERA5 public store (training) with ERA5T (live)
candidates.latency: ERA5T ends 6 days before the probe day (store attribute, last updated 2026-11-13 04:20 UTC)
candidates.size: 1.2 MB per global hourly field and layer (measured on 324 chunks)
candidates.access: anonymous (Google public bucket); the CDS route needs an account (not used)
candidates.verdict: passes (a), (c), (d), (e); (b) only with a declared lag of at least 7 days, measured once
candidates.why: not chosen: a week-old state, an update schedule nobody guarantees, one latency observation; kept as a possible later study if the bucket shows that wetness matters

candidates.candidate: ERA5 (training) with ECMWF IFS open-data analysis `vsw` (live, 12 UTC of D-1)
candidates.coverage: IFS open data carries `vsw` from 2024-11-13 (measured by index), so only as the live side
candidates.latency: the 12z run of D-1 is published by about 20 UTC of D-1 (ingest.ecmwf, phase6_ecmwf_publication)
candidates.size: about 0.3-0.5 MB per layer by byte range
candidates.why: mapping check against ERA5 on 54 days of 2025: root zone Spearman 0.80, rank difference 0.140; surface Spearman 0.85, rank difference 0.119 (criterion 0.80 and 0.10)

candidates.candidate: ERA5 (training) with NOAA GFS analysis SOILW (live, 00 UTC of D)
candidates.coverage: GFS analyses on the public bucket from 2021 (2018 absent), so only as the live side
candidates.latency: the 00z f000 file is out by about 04 UTC (live GFS ingest)
candidates.size: about 0.5 MB per layer by byte range
candidates.why: mapping check: root zone Spearman 0.85, rank difference 0.114; surface Spearman 0.86, rank difference 0.112; ERA5 00 UTC against its own 12 UTC, the reference a usable stand-in should approach: Spearman 0.99, rank difference 0.022

candidates.candidate: GLDAS Noah 2.1 (main and Early Product), GLDAS CLSM 2.2, FLDAS
candidates.latency: newest granule ended 105 / 29 / 74 / 44 days before the probe (CMR)
candidates.why: weeks to months behind real time; no live product of the same quantity

candidates.candidate: MERRA-2 land (NASA POWER GWETTOP / GWETROOT, already on disk for v2)
candidates.latency: newest M2T1NXLND granule ended 43 days before the probe (CMR)
candidates.why: weeks behind; and in v2 dropping these inputs changed development FA@90 by less than its SE (history below)

candidates.candidate: Bucket water balance on the IMERG Late store (this project's data), state at the end of IMD day D-2
candidates.coverage: IMERG Late from 2006-10-01, complete (0 missing days)
candidates.latency: lag 2 IMD days: in 32 of 33 published live runs the UTC day D-2 came from the Late store (run.json imd_day_inputs)
candidates.verdict: passes (a)-(e); identical in training and live by construction
candidates.why: chosen: the baseline any external product must beat, and no external product passed

candidates.candidate: Snow cover, MODIS MOD10C1 v061 (0.05 degree daily)
candidates.latency: newest granule ended 39 h before the probe (CMR): lag 3 days at 11:00 IST
candidates.access: Earthdata login (existing; NSIDC download not tested)
candidates.why: 7,619 of the 36,792 panel cells but only 40 of the 789 development positives lie at 3000 m or more; monsoon cloud cover over the snow map is not measured here; kept out to hold the candidate count small. A later study for the high cells, where October-December rain may fall as snow

C0.description: v3-live refit (reference): the frozen inputs with the v3 monotone constraints

w4_wet.description: C0 plus the three antecedent-wetness bucket inputs (lag 2 IMD days), each constrained non-decreasing

stage_one.rule: pooled OOF FA@90 is a false-alarm share (lower is better); passes when the paired bootstrap interval of w4_wet - C0 has lower bound <= 0, i.e. w4-wet is not significantly worse

flags.name: C1 where, not when
flags.rule: flag if FA@90 of v3 + iwet_sat_clim alone is at or below w4_wet's

flags.name: C2 reporting bias by built-up share
flags.rule: flag if the top lc_built tercile's w4_wet - C0 difference is negative while both others are at or above 0

flags.name: C3 missingness
flags.rule: flag if the NaN share of an input differs between positives and universe negatives by more than 1%

C0.description: v3-live refit (reference): the frozen inputs with the v3 monotone constraints

v5.description: v4 (C0, six rain-intensity inputs non-decreasing, nine physical static inputs unconstrained) plus the three antecedent-wetness inputs (non-decreasing)

stage.rule: pooled OOF FA@90 is a false-alarm share (lower is better); passes when the paired bootstrap interval of v5 - v4 has lower bound <= 0, i.e. v5 is not significantly worse

stage_one.rule: pooled OOF FA@90 is a false-alarm share (lower is better); passes when the paired bootstrap interval of v5 - C0 has lower bound <= 0, i.e. v5 is not significantly worse

against_incumbent.rule: pooled OOF FA@90 is a false-alarm share (lower is better); passes when the paired bootstrap interval of v5 - v4 has lower bound <= 0, i.e. v5 is not significantly worse
